people.name: Nazareth
people.line: The hometown of Jesus in Galilee

translations.web: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
translations.bsb: Then He went down to Nazareth with them and was obedient to them. But His mother treasured up all these things in her heart.
translations.kjv: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
translations.asv: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth; and he was subject unto them: and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.
